column1: # Reviewed capability gaps — accepted tier-1 findings from `pnpm capability-gaps`.
# Each line was checked against the excerpt the report printed.
# Rejected, and why they cannot be caught by a probe:
#   caroline-guitar-company-arigato  chorus     — names the sibling Somersault pedal
#   jhs-pedals-artificial-blonde     chorus     — names the sibling Emperor Chorus/Vibrato
#   roland-vp-550                    chorus     — "Mixed Chorus" is a choir voice, not the effect
#   dangerous-music-sum-minus        de-essing  — outboard gear you patch into its loops
#   dbx-160a                         de-essing  — needs an external EQ in the detector path
#   origin-effects-deluxe55          fuzz       — a tonal description of its overdrive
# Tier-2 findings accepted by hand, with the sentence that decided each.
# H90: "four new granular effects that create blooming reverse delays,
#       rhythmic glitchy stutters, and morphing textures"
# Second pass, after `pnpm derive-capabilities` made 143 more entries
# assessable and so probeable. Rejected here, none catchable by a probe:
#   deathbyaudio-thee-treble-overload chorus     — what you feed INTO it
#   deathbyaudio-thee-treble-overload fuzz       — names sibling Thee Fuzz Warr
#   deathbyaudio-disturbance          freeze     — freezes the LFO, not a buffer
#   deathbyaudio-fuzz-war             freq-shift — a tone control "acts as" one
#   walrus-audio-kangra-filter-fuzz   wah        — a quote about NOT sounding wah
#   source-audio-l-a-lady             fuzz       — heritage of an overdrive
#   joranalogue-audio-design-fold-6   harm-enh.  — a wavefolder is clipping
